citations.claim: EW still green at step 146 before emergency
EW truncated to yellow for only 1s when N emergency goes active at step 147
N turns green at step 148 with 0s all-red after EW yellow, violating 1s clearance

counterfactual.change: Removed the single emergency event (N at t147 duration 2); otherwise identical including 148 steps. Without preemption the cycle keeps normal yellow/all-red timing and no rule is violated.

explanation: Emergency preemption (N at t147) fires while EW is green (step 146). At step 147 EW is forced to yellow with the emergency active, then at step 148 NS is forced green. This preempting transition goes EW-yellow directly to NS-green, giving 0s of all-red (need 1s) and truncating EW yellow to 1s (need 6s). The controller's emergency hold path bypasses the normal yellow-timing and all-red-clearance interlock.

violation.detail: approach 0 turned green after only 0 s of all-red (need 1 s)

vision_note: Steps 145-146 show one direction holding green, then step 147 shows that direction forced to yellow while the cross direction is still red. Step 148 immediately shows the perpendicular direction already green with no all-red gap, so the yellow lasts only a single step.
